45.question: Match List I with List II: List I (Analytical Engine part) A. Punched-card control B. The Mill C. The Store List II (Role) 1. Basic flow control 2. Integrated memory 3. Arithmetic Logic Unit

92.question: Match List I with List II: List I (Term) A. User-defined functions B. Built-in functions C. Modular programming D. Code reusability List II (Description) 1. Eliminates code duplication 2. Available in standard library 3. Dividing into manageable sub-programs 4. Created by users

202.question: Match List I with List II: List I (Concept) A. Function overloading B. Polymorphism C. Operator overloading D. Overload resolution List II (Description) 1. Polymorphism via operators 2. Many forms 3. Same name, different parameters 4. Selecting the appropriate function
202.explanation: Function overloading reuses a name with different parameters, polymorphism means many forms, operator overloading gives operators new meanings and overload resolution picks the right function.

330.question: Match List I with List II: List I (Item) A. Memory B. Intel C. Microprocessor D. Clock List II (Role) 1. Major component performing all tasks 2. Stores instructions 3. Developed 4004 4. Drives the microprocessor

332.question: Match List I with List II: List I (Abbreviation) A. I/O B. CPU C. ALU D. IC List II (Stands for) 1. Central Processing Unit 2. Integrated Circuit 3. Input / Output 4. Arithmetic and Logic unit

365.question: Match List I with List II: List I (Software) A. Operating system B. Device drivers C. MS Word D. VLC media player List II (Purpose) 1. Play audio/video 2. Create text document 3. User interface 4. Run hardware

398.question: Match List I with List II: List I (OS function) A. File management B. Memory management C. Process management D. Security List II (Description) 1. Manages files and folders 2. Manages execution of tasks 3. Manages RAM 4. Protects the system
